overall: The AG found the Kingston Green Energy Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by not providing open session minutes within 10 days of a January 2013 request, which it supplied in March 2013; the AG ordered future compliance and closed the matter.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee failed to provide open session minutes after requesting copies of or access to all committee minutes ever held.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to make open session meeting minutes available within 10 days of a request

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that a future similar violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation.
